Concretely, violet is enforced in the ledger: The ledger rejects byte-identical submissions, forcing each clone to generate distinct work. Any meadow approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
